description: Get the market heatmap: coins (top10, top20, top30 or top50 by market cap, or one narrative's or ecosystem's members) or one tile per narrative or ecosystem, with price return (returns: 1h, 4h, 24h, 7d, 30d, 1y), funding APR (avgFundingApr), RSI(14), RVOL, open interest and OI value change (USD, oiChange24h); returns, funding and OI change are fractions (0.054 is 5.4%). Only eligible coins count: at least $1M market cap and $100K plausible volume, CoinGecko data under 48 hours old, and no stablecoins, wrapped or staked copies, LP tokens, funds or tokenized stocks and ETFs. Tiles are weighted baskets of every eligible member, with member coverage in `constituents` and the median member in `median`. Pass `ex` (CoinGecko ids, e.g. bitcoin,ethereum) to leave coins out; aggregate tiles are rebuilt without them. Refreshed every 3 hours, stale after 6 hours; candle and funding times are in `as_of`.

category.description: Coins-mode universe. `top10`, `top20`, `top30` and `top50` (the default) are the N largest eligible coins by market cap; the legacy `top-100` is an alias of `top50`. Otherwise one of the 15 narrative ids or 20 ecosystem ids (e.g. `layer-1`, `solana-ecosystem`), an alias such as `defi` or `sol`, or a /heatmap/<slug> page slug: the category's eligible members, of which the 50 largest are served; an ecosystem's members are the coins whose home chain it is. Ignored in the aggregate modes. Eligible coins: a 24h price change, market cap at least $1M, plausible 24h spot volume (at most 50x market cap) at least $100K, CoinGecko data under 48 hours old, and not a stablecoin, wrapped, bridged or staked copy, LP token, tokenized metal, fund, stock, ETF or pre-IPO token.

ex.description: Comma-separated CoinGecko coin ids to leave out, lower case (e.g. `bitcoin,ethereum`). Coins mode: removed after the Top N cut and never refilled, so `top10` with two member ids answers 8 coins. Aggregate modes: every tile is rebuilt from its members without them; a tile left with no member is dropped and counted in `omitted`. `excluded` lists the ids that were applied; the others are ignored and named in `meta.warnings`.

name: get_heatmap

HeatmapAsOf.description: When each non-CoinGecko metric was observed; every other field is as of `updated_at`.

candle_1h.description: The last closed hour, behind `returns.1h`, `returns.4h` and `rsi.1h`.

candle_4h.description: The end of the last closed UTC 4-hour block, behind `rsi.4h`.

HeatmapConstituents.description: Category tiles only: who the tile's numbers cover.

largest.description: The largest member by market cap and its share of the tile's market cap.

m.description: Tile members: the category's eligible members (an ecosystem's are the coins whose home chain it is), minus `ex`, with market cap above 0.

n.description: Members with a value, per metric.

weightCoverage.description: Share of the tile's weight carried by the members with a value: market cap for the price returns, open interest for avgFundingApr and oiChange24h, 24h volume for rvol. A weighted tile value is null below 0.5. Null when the tile has no weight.

emptyCategories.description: Categories fetched with no eligible member: left off the board, not counted as missing.

failedCategories.description: Ids of the configured categories whose fetch failed at the last refresh: missing from the board, the reason status is partial. Absent on a cache row written before this field existed.

status.description: `complete` when every configured category was fetched: availableCategories plus emptyCategories equals totalCategories.

avgFundingApr.description: Funding APR, a fraction per year (0.068 is 6.8%), as of `as_of.funding`. Coin: the funding snapshot's per-asset 8-hour average (one primary contract per venue, open-interest weighted when a majority of venues carry open interest, else the median; MEXC carries no weight) x 1,095, joined by coin id; null when no venue lists the coin under its own id. Category: open-interest weighted over the members with funding; null when they carry under half the tile's open interest.

fundingMethod.description: Coins only: how `avgFundingApr` was averaged across venues. Null with `avgFundingApr`.

fundingVenuesUsed.description: Coins only: venues behind `avgFundingApr`, one primary contract each.

id.description: Coin: the CoinGecko coin id (the id `ex` takes). Category: the narrative or ecosystem id.

kind.description: `coin`, or `category` for an aggregate tile (narratives and ecosystems modes). Field rules below are stated per kind.

marketCap.description: CoinGecko market cap. Category: the sum over the tile's members.

oiChange24h.description: OI value change (USD), 24h: summed USD open interest now over the same contracts' sum 24 hours earlier, minus 1, across the contracts present at both times (MEXC excluded). A change in USD value, so it moves with price as well as positioning. Category: the same sums over the tile's members; left out when they cover under half the tile's open interest.

openInterest.description: Open interest summed across venues by coin id, MEXC excluded. Category: the sum over the tile's members.

returns.description: Price return per window, a fraction (0.054 is 5.4%). Coin: 24h, 7d, 30d and 1y are CoinGecko's price changes read at the sync; 1h and 4h come from stored closed perp candles (venue order Binance, Bybit, OKX, Hyperliquid, joined by coin id), null when the coin has no perp series ending at `as_of.candle_1h`. Category: the basket's price return over the members with a value, each weighted by its market cap at the window start (members under 5% of the cap clamped against data faults); null when they carry under half the tile's market cap (the median member is in `median`).

1h.description: Coin: return over the last closed hour, ending at `as_of.candle_1h`.

3y.description: Always null today: the upstream market feed (CoinGecko /coins/markets) has no 3-year window.

4h.description: Coin: return over the last 4 closed hours, ending at `as_of.candle_1h`.

symbol.description: Coin: the ticker. Category: the tile's short name.

volume24h.description: Spot volume 24h (CoinGecko), left out when implausible: over 50x market cap, or, for a coin with $100B or more market cap, over 5x its median prior day. Category: the sum over the tile's members.

x.description: Relative volume (RVOL). Coin: 24h spot volume divided by the mean of its prior daily volumes (up to 10 days), capped at 10; null under 3 days of positive history. For a coin with $100B or more market cap, a day over 5x its median prior day is left out of the mean, and x is null when today's volume is. Category: the members' summed 24h volume over their summed mean prior daily volume, across members with at least 3 days of history; null when they carry under half the tile's volume.

HeatmapMedian.description: Category tiles only: the median member's price return, funding APR (fractions) and RVOL, beside the tile's weighted values. Each is null under 5 members with a value.

HeatmapRsi.description: Wilder RSI(14) per candle size, from the same perp series as `returns.1h`. Coin: null unless 64 contiguous closed bars end at `as_of.candle_1h` (1h), `as_of.candle_4h` (4h: four 1h candles per UTC 4-hour block) or `as_of.candle_1d` (1d). Category: the median member's RSI; null unless 5 members have a value or the members with one hold at least half the category's market cap.

as_of.description: Per-metric observation times; null on a cache row written before they existed.

coverage.description: Aggregate category coverage for narrative and ecosystem modes; null for coins mode.

eligible.description: Coins mode: the universe's size before `ex`: N for a Top N universe (capped at the coins cached), every eligible member for one category (of which `dots` are the 50 largest). Null in the aggregate modes.

excluded.description: The `ex` ids that were applied: members of this coin universe, or of at least one category in the aggregate modes. Empty when `ex` is absent or could not be applied (see `meta.warnings`).

omitted.description: Aggregate modes: categories left off because `ex` removed every member. Null in coins mode.

updated_at.description: ISO timestamp for the populated heatmap cache.

meta.description: Which route answered, what the API said about the data's freshness, and whether the client cut the answer to fit the agent's context window.

route.description: Always `v1`: every call reads the keyed /v1 route.

truncated.description: True when the answer is cut short: by the API's row budget, or by the client (`truncated_fields`).

truncated_fields.description: The arrays and strings the client cut, by JSON path in `data`: `total` items received, `showing` kept, `kept: latest` when an oldest-first series kept its newest items.

warnings.description: What the API or the client could not do, in words. State them with the answer.

pagination.description: Present when the answer is one page: pass `cursor` back to read the next one.

title: Market heatmap
